story: Tracewell Heating & Air has been fixing and fitting heating and cooling systems since 2011. We are based at 1200 Tracer Ridge Rd in Winter Park, and we work for homeowners and property managers across Winter Park, Maitland and Oviedo.
Tess Tracewell owns the company. That means the person whose name is on the truck is the person you can talk to. We are licensed under CAC1800177, and we were given the TW Test Award 2025.

The way we work is simple. You tell us what the system is doing, we come out and trace the problem back to its cause, and we tell you what it costs before we touch anything. No surprise line items at the end. We will text you before we arrive so you are not sitting by the window all morning.

Our office hours are Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. We also run 24/7 emergency HVAC service, so if the air quits on a Saturday night you can still call. We install and service Carrier and Trane equipment.

services.title: Heating and cooling work across Winter Park
services.sub: Three things we do, for homeowners and property managers in Winter Park, Maitland and Oviedo. Call us and we will trace down the issue.

items.d: Cool air back in the house, whether that means a repair, a tune up, or a brand new system fitted.
items.detail: If your air conditioning has stopped, slowed down, or started making a noise you do not like, we will find out why and tell you what it costs to put right. When a unit is past saving, we size and install a replacement rather than selling you more system than the house needs. We fit Carrier and Trane.

page.intro: We install and service air conditioning in Winter Park homes, and booking is a phone call to Tracewell Heating & Air. Tell us what the system is doing, warm air, ice on the lines, odd noises, and we will trace it down. New installs include sizing for your home, removal of the old unit, the permit and inspection, and our TW coil rinse.
expect: Call us to book. We answer Mon to Fri, 8am to 5pm.
We text before we arrive, so you are not guessing.
Service calls start at $149, priced upfront before work starts.
A full install usually takes about half a day.

faq.a: We carry Carrier and Trane, and new installs we put in are Carrier. Call and tell us what you have so we can sort it out before we come.
Our regular hours are Mon to Fri, 8am to 5pm. We also run 24/7 emergency service, so if the AC quits on a Saturday, call us any time, day or night.

faq.q: My AC is blowing warm air. Is that a repair or a new unit?
faq.a: Often it is a repair, and we will tell you which it is after we look. You get the price upfront either way, no surprises later.

faq.q: There is ice on the lines. Should I shut it off?
faq.a: Yes, shut the system off and call us. Running it iced up can make the problem worse before we get there.

faq.q: Do you handle the permit for a new system?
faq.a: Yes. The permit and inspection are part of the install, along with sizing the unit for your home and hauling off the old one.

items.d: Heat that comes on when you ask for it, with a straight answer on whether to fix the furnace or swap it.
items.detail: Cold mornings in Central Florida are short but they still catch people out. We check the furnace, trace the fault, and give you the price before we begin. If replacing it makes more sense than repairing it, we will say so and explain why.

items.d: A look at the attic fan so hot air is moving out of the roof instead of pushing back into your rooms.
items.detail: An attic fan that has quietly stopped working makes the whole house harder to cool and the AC work longer than it should. We test the fan, check it is pulling the way it should, and report back on what we found. Handy to book alongside AC service.
